name: 06_kubernetes_anchored
description: A LargeDataUpload-anchored incident, primary source kubernetes rather than azure_monitor. Exercises the orchestrator's connector order for LargeDataUpload (azure_monitor, kubernetes, iam_logs, github_commits) - a different sequence than the storage-bucket scenarios. Reminder: the mocked connectors (app/orchestrator/connectors.py) return fixed storage/CDN-flavored evidence text regardless of scenario, so narrate the FP-gate scoring and connector selection here, not the Evidence tab's literal content.
expected_outcome: signal 1 alone: 30 (high) + 10 (1 type) + 18 (kubernetes) + 5 (8.7GB upload anomaly) = 63 -> queued. After signal 2 correlates (severity escalates high -> critical, 2 types): 40 + 25 + 18 + 5 = 88 -> investigating.
